claim.notes: CFR+ (simultaneous updates, exact chance enumeration, linear averaging), 11250 iterations, time-boxed. Exploitability is still decreasing roughly as 1/T, so the strategy is approximate, not converged. Value -0.0858 is consistent with the published Leduc value (about -0.0856), which I recalled rather than checked. Two model bugs were found and fixed during development: a first-action check wrongly ended the round, and an earlier alternating-update variant converged more slowly; the final run uses simultaneous updates. The best-response code was checked only against random deviations.
